description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Sinnathamby Mahenthiran as Chairman of the Valikamam South west Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for the Chairman of a local authority (Valikamam South West Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for a specific local government position, including the reason for the vacancy (death), the procedure for nomination by a recognized political party, and the official declaration of the newly elected Chairman. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and declarations at the local government level.
